title: Moss and the Hoe
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'ew' and 'oe'.

pages.brief: A plain garden hoe leaning against a wooden fence.
Close view of a hoe's long wooden handle and flat metal end.
The flat end of a hoe digging up a small weed from the soil.
Moss the hedgehog digging in the soil with his own small claws.
Close view of Moss the hedgehog's sharp claws on one foot.
Moss the hedgehog's claw next to a hoe's flat end, shown side by side.
Moss the hedgehog digging quickly, soil flying up behind him.
A hoe cutting a long straight trench through the soil.
Moss the hedgehog digging a smaller, quicker hole beside the long trench.
A hoe and Moss the hedgehog's claws both shown digging in the same patch of soil.
